Work-in-progress of yet another cat race for Rimworld.
https://github.com/scradampoop/RimWorldCheech (hyperlink from Advanced menu)
--- Change Log --- v0.3.0, published 2026-05-30 • Added 5 more face accent patterns • Cheeches now occasionally spawn with hair, beards, and/or cheech-specific names • Non-combat-centric NPC cheeches spawn only with pants, in order to show off their coats • Tail offset fixes and jaguar face accent pattern fix v0.2.0, published 2026-05-27 • Rewrote color picker UI • Added ability to swap coat pattern genes via color picker UI v0.1.0, published 2026-05-24 • Initial release
--- Credits --- Diana (Kitty) Winters: Orassans textures and inspiration. Anthrosonae mod team: Color picker and gene binding code. VRE - Saurid mod team: Example for writing a Xenotype mod. FluffierThanThou: Advanced color picker code.
